senses.definition: Lose force or severity, or reduce the force of something; said of storms, pain, noise or strong feelings.
senses.plain_language_definition: To die down or grow weaker, like a storm that slowly calms.

senses.definition: Markedly different from an accepted norm.
senses.plain_language_definition: Different from what is ordinary, expected, or accepted as normal.

senses.definition: Slip away in secret, often taking money or goods that belong to others, to avoid being caught.
senses.plain_language_definition: To run off in secret, often with stolen money, so you will not get caught.

senses.definition: Hold back by choice from doing or having something, especially a pleasure such as alcohol or rich food.
senses.plain_language_definition: To choose not to do or have something you might enjoy, like drinking.

senses.definition: Speak to someone seriously about a fault or mistake, as a warning not to repeat it.
senses.plain_language_definition: To warn or scold someone in a serious but calm way.

senses.definition: Lower the quality of a substance by secretly mixing in something cheaper, weaker or harmful.
senses.plain_language_definition: To spoil food, drink or medicine by mixing in something cheaper or harmful.

senses.definition: Relating to beauty, or to the way people judge and enjoy it.
senses.plain_language_definition: Having to do with beauty and how good something looks.

senses.definition: Raise the power or standing of a person or group, or make them look more important than they are.
senses.plain_language_definition: To make someone more powerful or important, or to make them seem that way.

senses.definition: The quality of responding quickly and gladly, without any sign of reluctance.
senses.plain_language_definition: Being quick and happy to do something as soon as you are asked.

senses.definition: Lessen pain, distress or a problem so that a person can cope with it more easily, even if it does not go away.
senses.plain_language_definition: To make pain, worry or a problem less bad.

senses.definition: Join two or more separate things, such as companies, groups or metals, so that they form a single body.
senses.plain_language_definition: To merge separate groups or things into one.

senses.definition: Unclear in meaning because it can reasonably be taken in more than one way.
senses.plain_language_definition: Could mean two or more things, so it is hard to tell which one is meant.

senses.definition: Pulled between opposite feelings about the same person or thing, such as attraction and dislike.
senses.plain_language_definition: Having mixed feelings, partly for something and partly against it.

senses.definition: Improve conditions that are bad or hard to bear, such as poverty, illness or unrest.
senses.plain_language_definition: To improve a bad situation or condition.

senses.definition: Something located at a time when it could not have existed or occurred.
senses.plain_language_definition: Something that appears in the wrong historical era.

senses.definition: Similar or equivalent in some respects though otherwise dissimilar.
senses.plain_language_definition: Like something else in some ways, though different in others.

senses.definition: A thing or result that breaks an established pattern and so stands out as odd or hard to explain.
senses.plain_language_definition: Something odd that does not fit the usual pattern.

senses.definition: A deep-rooted, lasting dislike of a person, group or thing.
senses.plain_language_definition: A deep dislike of someone or something that makes you want to stay away.

senses.definition: The object of a feeling of intense aversion; something to be avoided.
senses.plain_language_definition: A specific person or thing that is the target of intense hatred and must be avoided at all costs.

senses.definition: A state of indifference in which a person feels no urge to care, take interest or act.
senses.plain_language_definition: Not caring about something, and so not bothering to do anything about it.

senses.definition: Quiet the anger or demands of a person or group by giving them some or all of what they want.
senses.plain_language_definition: To calm an angry person by giving in to what they want.

senses.definition: Needing great and sustained effort of body or mind, so that it tires out whoever does it.
senses.plain_language_definition: Needing so much effort that it wears you out.

senses.definition: Put a thought or feeling into clear, well-organized words.
senses.plain_language_definition: To say clearly what you think or feel.

senses.definition: Practicing strict self-denial and giving up comfort and pleasure, often for religious reasons.
senses.plain_language_definition: Living very simply and refusing comforts and pleasures on purpose.

senses.definition: Ease a painful or unwelcome feeling, such as guilt, fear or grief, so that it troubles someone less.
senses.plain_language_definition: To ease a bad feeling, such as worry or guilt.

senses.definition: Daring enough to try something risky that most people would not attempt.
senses.plain_language_definition: Very bold and ready to take big chances.

senses.definition: Unrestrained by convention or propriety.
senses.plain_language_definition: Disrespectfully bold and showing no regard for normal rules or manners.

senses.definition: Stripped down to what is needed, with nothing added for decoration or comfort.
senses.plain_language_definition: Very plain and bare, with nothing extra for looks or comfort.

senses.definition: Of a stern or strict bearing or demeanor; forbidding in aspect.
senses.plain_language_definition: Having a serious, cold, or intimidating look and personality.

senses.definition: Practicing great self-denial.
senses.plain_language_definition: Living a very strict lifestyle without luxuries or physical pleasures.

senses.definition: Put forward something as a definite fact, speaking as one who has no doubt about it.
senses.plain_language_definition: To say that something is true and leave no room for doubt.

senses.definition: Repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse.
senses.plain_language_definition: Boring because everyone has heard or seen it many times before.

senses.definition: Cover up the true nature of something with an outward appearance that suggests otherwise.
senses.plain_language_definition: To make something seem different from how it really is.

senses.definition: Active in helping others, often through generous gifts or kind deeds.
senses.plain_language_definition: Kind and generous, doing good things to help other people.

senses.definition: Make something such as an argument, a mood or an economy stronger by adding support to it.
senses.plain_language_definition: To give something extra support so that it becomes stronger.

senses.definition: Padded with grand, showy wording that hides how little is actually being said.
senses.plain_language_definition: Using big, fancy words to seem important.

senses.definition: Rough and rude in manner, with no sense of what others find polite.
senses.plain_language_definition: Rude and loud, with bad manners.

senses.definition: Grow, spread or increase quickly and with fresh energy.
senses.plain_language_definition: To grow fast and spread out, like new leaves in spring.

senses.definition: Strengthen an argument, position or plan by adding evidence or support that makes it harder to attack.
senses.plain_language_definition: To back up an idea or plan so it is harder to knock down.

senses.definition: A din of loud, clashing sounds with no harmony between them.
senses.plain_language_definition: A jumble of loud noises that hurts the ears.

senses.definition: Talk someone into doing what they would rather not, using charm, praise and patient pleading.
senses.plain_language_definition: To get someone to do something by sweet talk and praise.

senses.definition: Grown so hard and unfeeling that other people's pain or misfortune stirs no pity.
senses.plain_language_definition: Not caring at all when other people are hurt or in trouble.

senses.definition: Having calluses; having skin made tough and thick through wear.
senses.plain_language_definition: Having skin that has become thick and hard from frequent friction.

senses.definition: Openness in saying what one really thinks, even when the truth is awkward or unwelcome.

senses.definition: Inclined to switch moods or plans suddenly, with nothing to explain the change.
senses.plain_language_definition: Likely to change suddenly, so you cannot predict what will happen next.

senses.definition: Determined by chance or impulse or whim rather than by necessity or reason.

senses.definition: Criticize or reprimand someone severely.

senses.definition: Inflict severe punishment on.

senses.definition: Something or someone that causes an important change or event to happen.
senses.plain_language_definition: A person or thing that starts or speeds up a big change.

senses.definition: Harsh or corrosive in tone.
senses.plain_language_definition: Bitterly sarcastic in a way that is meant to hurt.

senses.definition: Of a substance, especially a strong acid; capable of destroying or eating away by chemical action.
senses.plain_language_definition: Able to burn or destroy skin and materials through chemical action.

senses.definition: Crafty deception, such as twisting rules, exploiting loopholes or using misleading arguments, to get one's way, especially in law, politics or business.
senses.plain_language_definition: Sly tricks and misleading talk used to cheat people or get an unfair edge.

senses.definition: Thicken from a liquid into a soft or solid mass, as blood does when it clots and milk when it curdles.
senses.plain_language_definition: To change from a runny liquid into a thick or solid mass.

senses.definition: Of separate parts, join up and become a single combined mass, group or idea.
senses.plain_language_definition: To come together and become one group or thing.

senses.definition: Convincing because the reasoning behind it is sound, clear and to the point.
senses.plain_language_definition: So clear and sensible that people find it convincing.

senses.definition: Matching something else in amount, size or degree, so that the two are in fair proportion.
senses.plain_language_definition: In the right amount to match something else, like pay that fits the work done.

senses.definition: Showing a cheerful willingness to do favors for others.
senses.plain_language_definition: Eager to please others and quick to go along with their wishes.

senses.definition: Meant to ease anger or hostility and win back someone's goodwill.
senses.plain_language_definition: Trying to calm someone's anger and make peace.

senses.definition: Allow misconduct to go on without objecting to it or punishing it, as if giving it silent approval.
senses.plain_language_definition: To let bad behavior slide without punishing it.

senses.definition: A very intense and uncontrolled fire.
senses.plain_language_definition: A massive and destructive fire that gets out of hand.

senses.definition: A person with deep knowledge and practiced taste who can judge quality in an art or in luxuries such as food or wine.
senses.plain_language_definition: Someone who knows a great deal about a fine thing, like wine or art, and can tell good from bad.

senses.definition: Showing sincere, humble regret for a wrong one has done, along with a wish to make amends.
senses.plain_language_definition: Deeply sorry for doing something wrong.

senses.definition: A baffling puzzle or situation that seems to have no clear solution.

senses.definition: Supplied or present in great quantity.

senses.definition: Flooding caused by a tumultuous breakup of ice in a river during the spring or summer.

senses.definition: Prove that a popular story, claim or reputation is untrue or overblown, usually by laying out the facts against it.
senses.plain_language_definition: To prove that something many people believe is wrong.

senses.definition: Conduct that keeps to good manners and suits the seriousness of the occasion.
senses.plain_language_definition: Polite, respectful behavior that fits a formal place or event.

senses.definition: The habit or act of giving way to someone else, out of respect for their age, rank or knowledge.
senses.plain_language_definition: Letting someone else decide or have their way because you respect them.

senses.definition: Courteous regard for people's feelings.

senses.definition: Damaging to health, to living things or to the proper working of something.

senses.definition: Speak of someone or something with mocking scorn, as if it deserved no respect.

senses.definition: Copied or adapted from the work of others; not original.

senses.plain_language_definition: To make something totally dry, for example to keep food from going bad.

senses.definition: Carried out casually and without method, skipping from one thing to another with little real effort.
senses.plain_language_definition: Done without any real plan or focus, jumping randomly from one thing to another.

senses.definition: Thin and delicate enough to let light through, so that shapes behind it show faintly.
senses.plain_language_definition: So light and thin that light can shine right through it.

senses.definition: Aimed chiefly at instructing or giving moral lessons, often to the point of seeming preachy.

senses.definition: Unsure of one's own worth or ability, and so quiet and reluctant to put oneself forward.
senses.plain_language_definition: Shy and unsure of yourself, so you tend to hold back.

senses.definition: Slow to act or get things done, or designed to stall and buy time.

senses.definition: A song or hymn of mourning composed or performed as a memorial to a dead person.

senses.definition: Rid someone of a false idea or illusion by showing them how things really are.

senses.definition: Not in agreement; at odds or in conflict with something else.
senses.plain_language_definition: Clashing with each other and failing to agree.

senses.definition: A difference between conflicting facts or claims or opinions.
senses.plain_language_definition: An inconsistency or mismatch between things that should match.

senses.definition: An event that departs from expectations.

senses.definition: Speak scornfully of a person or thing so that others think less of it.
senses.plain_language_definition: To speak about someone or something as if they are not worth much.

senses.definition: Unlike one another in their basic makeup, sharing few or no features.
senses.plain_language_definition: Of very different kinds, with almost nothing alike about them.

senses.definition: Put on a false show so that others cannot see what one really feels or intends.
senses.plain_language_definition: To hide what you really think or feel by acting as if you feel something else.

senses.definition: Behave unnaturally or affectedly.
senses.plain_language_definition: To act weirdly fake or put on airs.

senses.definition: Send information or ideas out to many people so that they become widely known.
senses.plain_language_definition: To spread information or ideas so that many people learn about them.

senses.definition: A tense clash between things that do not fit together, such as opposing views or a person's words and actions.
senses.plain_language_definition: A clash between ideas, feelings or actions that do not agree with each other.

senses.definition: Swell and stretch outward because something inside is pressing on it.
senses.plain_language_definition: To swell out and stretch, usually because too much has been put inside.

senses.definition: Stating beliefs as certain truths that cannot be questioned, and refusing to consider other views.
senses.plain_language_definition: So sure your beliefs are right that you will not listen to other views.

senses.definition: Likely to be false, dishonest or of poor quality, and so not to be fully trusted.
senses.plain_language_definition: Probably not true, honest or good, so you should be careful about trusting it.

senses.definition: Bursting with joyful excitement that one cannot easily hold back.
senses.plain_language_definition: So happy and excited that it seems to bubble out of you.

senses.definition: Picking freely from many traditions, styles or sources, or made up of things picked that way.
senses.plain_language_definition: Made up of a mix of things picked from many different styles or places.

senses.definition: A remedy's or plan's power to bring about the change it aims at.

senses.definition: Bold, disrespectful behavior from someone who should know they have no right to act that way.
senses.plain_language_definition: The nerve to do or say something rude that you have no right to.

senses.definition: A mournful poem; a lament for the dead.
senses.plain_language_definition: A sad poem written to honor someone who has passed away.

senses.definition: Skilled at putting thoughts into well-chosen words that move or convince people.
senses.plain_language_definition: Good with words, so that what you say or write is clear and moves people.

senses.plain_language_definition: To add extra details, often made up, to a story so it sounds better than what really happened.

senses.plain_language_definition: To cause a feeling or reaction to happen.

senses.plain_language_definition: To produce offspring through biological reproduction.

senses.definition: Lasting only a brief time before it fades or disappears.
senses.plain_language_definition: Here for a very short while and then gone.

senses.definition: A short, sharply worded saying or poem that makes its point with a clever twist.
senses.plain_language_definition: A short, witty saying that makes a point in very few words.

senses.definition: Deeply learned, with knowledge built up through years of study and wide reading.
senses.plain_language_definition: Knowing a great deal because you have read and studied widely.

senses.definition: Confined to and understandable by only an enlightened inner circle.

senses.plain_language_definition: A speech praising someone who has recently passed away.

senses.definition: Vanishing almost as soon as it appears; very short-lived.

senses.plain_language_definition: To make a bad situation or problem even worse.

senses.definition: Demanding a quick response because a situation is serious and cannot wait.

senses.plain_language_definition: To officially clear someone of blame or criminal charges.

senses.definition: Serving a short-term advantage or self-interest rather than what is fair or principled.
senses.plain_language_definition: Useful for gaining a personal advantage rather than being right.

senses.definition: Appropriate to a purpose; practical.
senses.plain_language_definition: Sensible and practical for a particular situation.

senses.definition: Remove something completely, especially from a record, list or text, so that no trace is left.
senses.plain_language_definition: To erase or wipe out completely from a record or memory.

senses.definition: Praise someone or something with great enthusiasm, often in public.
senses.plain_language_definition: To praise or speak very highly of someone or something.

senses.definition: Not pertinent to the matter under consideration.
senses.plain_language_definition: Irrelevant or completely unrelated to the current topic.

senses.definition: Making light of something serious by joking about it at the wrong time.
senses.plain_language_definition: Joking when you are supposed to be serious.

senses.definition: Based on faulty reasoning or a mistaken belief, and so likely to mislead.
senses.plain_language_definition: Based on a flawed argument or incorrect logic.

senses.definition: Characterized by intense emotion.
senses.plain_language_definition: Filled with fiery passion or strong feelings.

senses.definition: Marked by erratic changeableness in affections or attachments.
senses.plain_language_definition: Constantly changing who you like or care about.

senses.definition: Liable to sudden unpredictable change.
senses.plain_language_definition: Unpredictable and likely to change at any moment.

senses.definition: Treat with contemptuous disregard.
senses.plain_language_definition: Openly disobeying a rule or law on purpose.

senses.definition: Laugh at with contempt and derision.
senses.plain_language_definition: Mocking or making fun of something with disrespect.

senses.definition: Work to provoke or build up trouble, such as unrest, hatred or revolt.
senses.plain_language_definition: Causing trouble or rebellion by encouraging people to get angry.

senses.definition: Bathe with warm water or medicated lotions.
senses.plain_language_definition: To wash or soothe a body part using warm liquids or soothing lotions.

senses.definition: Stop a likely event from happening by acting before it can.
senses.plain_language_definition: To stop something before it starts by acting early.

senses.definition: Coming about by chance, without being planned or intended.
senses.plain_language_definition: Happening by chance, not because anyone planned it.

senses.definition: Occurring by happy chance.
senses.plain_language_definition: Happening by a lucky accident or fortunate stroke of fate.

senses.definition: Stubbornly resistant to authority or control.
senses.plain_language_definition: Unruly and hard to control, often quarrelling with those in charge.

senses.definition: Easily irritated or annoyed.
senses.plain_language_definition: Grouchy, touchy, and easily set off by minor inconveniences.

senses.definition: Unpredictably difficult in operation; likely to be troublesome.
senses.plain_language_definition: Hard to manage or handle because it tends to cause problems.

senses.definition: Using money, food and other resources sparingly, with nothing wasted.
senses.plain_language_definition: Careful about spending money and resources.

senses.definition: Talking far more than anyone wants to hear, usually about small things.

senses.definition: Drawn to other people and happiest when spending time in a group.
senses.plain_language_definition: Liking to be around other people and making friends easily.

senses.plain_language_definition: A long, angry lecture aimed at a crowd or at one person.

senses.definition: The particular words and turns of phrase that a group, trade or field habitually uses.

senses.definition: Taking an interest only in local affairs and the concerns of one's own community, while ignoring the larger picture.

senses.definition: Of a size, quantity or power far beyond the normal, enough to inspire wonder.

senses.definition: The source of something: the place, maker or setting it first arose from.

senses.definition: Unfair, cruel or excessive to a shocking degree, beyond any decent excuse.

senses.definition: Utter and total, with no saving feature to lessen it; said mostly of bad things.

senses.definition: Wrong for the occasion, in a way that offends the manners people expect there.

senses.definition: Taking part in something without knowing its true nature or purpose.

senses.definition: Having its surface broken up by marks of a second or third color.

senses.definition: Brag about something, crediting it with more glory than it has.

senses.definition: Felt in the gut as an instant, instinctive reaction that comes before any reasoning.
senses.plain_language_definition: Felt strongly in your gut, as a reaction that comes before thinking.

senses.definition: Sharpen or awaken a desire, especially an appetite or a person's curiosity.
senses.plain_language_definition: To make you hungrier for food, news or fun than you were before.

senses.definition: Pry something from another's grip, whether a thing in their hands or their control of a place or group.
senses.plain_language_definition: To fight someone for something they are holding onto and come away with it.

The hungry dog sat beside the table, tantalized by a steak it was not allowed to touch.

Her memoir describes the travails of raising three children alone while working two jobs.

Few tourists who climb the cathedral steps think about the travail of the masons who carved every stone by hand.

The director imbued the old fairy tale with a dark, uneasy mood that kept audiences on edge.
Their grandfather's war stories imbued the boys with a deep sense of duty to their country.

She saw the gold-plated mansion, with its fountains and marble lions, as the antithesis of good taste.

His name has been bandied around as a possible candidate, though he has never said he wants the job.
Pundits bandy the word crisis about so freely that many viewers have stopped listening.

A singer who owes her big break to one producer may stay beholden to him for years, recording whatever songs he picks.
The scientists turned down money from the oil company so that their findings would not look beholden to it.

She waited until after dessert to broach the idea of selling the family house.
Doctors learn to broach bad news gently, starting with what the patient already knows.
Nobody on the team dared to broach the missed deadline while the boss was still fuming.
When he finally broached the idea of moving abroad, his wife admitted she had been thinking the same thing.

The goalkeeper was a bulwark all season, stopping shot after shot as the defense in front of him fell apart.
Volunteer fire crews were the village's only bulwark against the wildfires that swept the hills each summer.

He took the overseas posting mainly to burnish his record for a top job in Washington.

A string of glowing reviews further burnished the young chef's reputation.
A canny negotiator, she let the other side talk first and learned exactly how much they were willing to pay.

The skier caught an edge and careened off the trail into a stand of pines.
Kids on sleds careened past us, shrieking, as they bounced over the bumps.

During the negotiation, the mediator asked both parties to ignore extraneous grievances.

Paper lanterns, luminous with the candles burning inside them, floated up over the river during the festival.
On summer evenings the fireflies turned the meadow into a field of tiny luminous specks blinking on and off.
Through the fog, the lighthouse lamp was a luminous smudge that grew sharper as the boat drew closer.
